title: Yao Lao Against Yun Shan
summary: Yao Lao, fighting in Xiao Yan's body, trades blows with Yun Shan, and the clash tears the void. Away from the fight, Nalan Yanran tells Yun Yun she regrets breaking off the engagement and asks to enter the Gate of Life and Death. Yun Yun warns that it needs at least the Dou Ling rank but agrees to raise it with Yun Shan. Onlookers note that Xiao Yan now fights at about Dou Zong level and uses only an apricot-white flame. Yun Shan gathers the elders into the Covering Sun Cloud Formation, saying he cannot let a future Dou Zong who hates the sect escape. Yao Lao agrees to retreat, and Xiao Yan vows to return one day to settle his father's disappearance. When Yun Shan catches up, Xiao Yan readies another Lotus Flame.
